name: Higgsfield Canvas
desc: Infinite node board that links steps into one workflow
desc_zh: 把各步骤连成一条工作流的无限节点画板
solves: Ideas, references and outputs were scattered across generations; connect them as nodes on one board.
solves_zh: 创意、参考和成品散落在一次次生成里；在一个画板上用节点把它们连起来。
best_for: A pitch needs moodboard, stills and a clip that all match; lay them out on Canvas so each feeds the next.
best_for_zh: 提案里的情绪板、静帧和短片要风格统一；摆在 Canvas 上，让上一步喂给下一步。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog (entry 'Higgsfield Canvas')）。 Outside the window but absent from the ledger. 首次公开日期来源：https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog
